title: Compact training builder keyboard and scroll
summary: Explore the training builder on a compact viewport while keyboard focus, measured scrolling, search, and save controls change visibility.
allowedActions: Reset the declared owned fixture and confirm the target identity
Open the professional training builder and observe the initial hierarchy or accessibility tree
Focus documented inputs, open the keyboard, and use selector or role based scrolling
Open exercise search, enter the declared query, inspect results, and close the search surface
Record visible state, request outcomes, screenshots, and hierarchy evidence after each action
excludedExternalEffects: Purchases, subscriptions, provider-console changes, issue posting, or scheduling
Unscoped database writes, direct seed actions for behavior under test, or destructive deletion
Coordinate taps, arbitrary sleeps, selector healing, or AI visual assertions as a required verdict

scenario.title: Compact training builder remains usable while the keyboard and scroll state changes
preconditions: A fresh professional training draft is reset for the selected locale
The target build and connector are independently identified before actions
The exercise catalog and owned API origin are healthy for this attempt
actions: Open the builder on the compact target
Focus the plan name or exercise search field and observe keyboard-visible bounds
Scroll to the next documented action using a semantic selector
Search for the canonical exercise and close the search surface
expectedObservations: The focused control remains reachable and its label or accessibility identity is stable
The active action is visible without coordinate fallback or arbitrary waiting
Search results and close controls remain within the compact viewport
No observation is classified as a defect until it is compared with the cited requirements
